results.title: Results
results.intro: Build a batch's board results from the live grades, then approve them once the college board has.
results.chooseBatch: Choose the faculty, academic year and semester (and the acceptance year, if you narrowed to one) to see the sheet.
results.empty: No results match the selected filters
results.headerHint: Fill in the header where it prints on the sheet. It prints in English, so type in English; a blank field prints as dots to fill in by hand.
results.resultTitleTip: Enter the type of the exam result if needed, e.g. Sup, Sub, etc. Leave it blank to print no line here.
results.headerEdited: You changed the header. Regenerate to save it: until then, the export and approval use the saved header.

errors.alreadyApproved: These results are already approved and can't be regenerated.
errors.regularNotApproved: The semester's results must be approved before Sup & Sub results.
errors.emptyBatch: This batch has no students or no curriculums in this semester.
errors.stale: The grades changed since these results were generated. Regenerate them, then approve.
errors.noResits: No re-exam marks have been entered yet. Enter them in the Sup & Sub marks below, then generate.

results.staleText: These board results no longer match the grades. Regenerate them before they can be approved.
results.approveMessage: Approve only once the college board has approved these results. The batch's grades for this semester will be locked and the final results can be exported.
results.discardMessage: Discard these board results? The grades are not touched, and the results can be generated again.
results.pendingHint: Export the board results for the college board. Once they approve, come back and approve them here.
results.lockedError: This semester's results are approved, so its grades can no longer change.
results.resitText: Enter the re-exam marks: supplementary for an F (counted as at most C) and substitute for an excused absence. Then generate the Sup & Sub results: they list only the students with a re-exam mark entered.
results.resitLockedText: The Sup & Sub results are approved, so these marks can no longer change.
results.saveResitFor: Save the re-exam mark for {{name}} in {{course}}
results.clearResitFor: Remove the re-exam mark for {{name}} in {{course}}
results.noResitCandidates: No student needs a re-exam in this semester
results.resitLocked: The Sup & Sub results are approved, so this mark can no longer change.
results.loadForEditingFor: Load the results of {{name}} for editing
results.editingLoaded: You're editing results already generated. Correct marks or remove students below, then update them; they replace the pending board results.
results.alreadyApproved: These results are already approved, so the batch's grades are locked.
results.startOverMessage: Clear the chosen batch, the students removed from it and the header typed so far? Grade corrections are already saved and stay as they are.
results.draftKept: Your choices here are kept on this device, even after a refresh, until the results are generated or you start over.
results.newHint: Choose the faculty, academic year and semester. The sheet below is built from the grades as they stand: click a cell to correct a mark, or remove a student from this result, then generate.
results.generatedHint: Board results already generated, narrowed by the choices above. Open one to export, approve or continue it.
results.alreadyGenerated: Board results were already generated for this selection.
results.previewHint: Click a mark to correct the student's grade. The remove button (×) at the end of a row takes the student off this result only.
results.remarksHint: The Remarks column fills in by itself from the semester's GPA: Pas, Sup/Sub with how many, or Rpt. Pick another remark from the status key in any row.
results.openItemsHint: These grades haven't been settled yet. You can settle them here, or approve with them as they are.
results.regenerateBeforeApprove: The sheet will be regenerated from the current grades before it is approved.
